title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-priya-nair-max-evans-2026-03-12
content:
Objective: Prep for weekly 1:1 with Max (AE) — focus on high-priority accounts, blocker removal, ramp progress for new CSM handoffs, and quick wins for Q2 renewals.

Time: 30 min (keep to 30)
Agenda (prioritized):
1) Quick wins / wins to amplify (3-4 min)
   - Team secured demo with ParkCorp (targeting POC next week) — ask Max for latest slides + intro to technical contact.
   - Up-sell opportunity at BrightHealth (embedding pilot) — confirm pricing ask / margin targets.
2) At-risk accounts & mitigation (8-10 min)
   - NovaRetail (churn risk): weekly latency spikes reported after model update (2026-03-02). Action: coordinate with eng SRE (Ethan) to get trace and timeline. Need ETA on rollback or patch.
   - LatticeAI: adoption stalled — low usage of embeddings; sales conversation scheduled 03/18. Prep questions: what blockers did they list? who is the internal champion?
3) Handoffs & coverage (5 min)
   - Two new mid-market accounts (Onward Health, SolvTech) moved to CSM queue — check Max's notes on commercial commitments and any custom SLAs. Confirm kickoff timings.
4) Ramp / enablement needs (5 min)
   - Max feedback: wants a one-pager on common performance troubleshooting (latency + token cost) to send to customers. TODO: Draft + share by 03/16.
   - Need short checklist for private deployment security questions (KM integration, VPC) for pre-sales.
5) Next steps, blockers, and personal check-in (3-4 min)

Notes / talking points: 
- NovaRetail: customer reports 300–500ms tail latency spikes on long sessions (>1k tokens). They saw the spikes after we rolled quantized model v1.4. Link to support ticket: JIRA-RI-7890. Quick ask for Max: get permission to share logs with SRE and ask them to map traffic windows.
- BrightHealth: opportunity to add token-level pricing (they asked for cost estimate on 1M tokens/month). Ballpark numbers: hosted API standard q4 pricing (reference internal pricing doc). Confirm whether they prefer Dedicated.
- ParkCorp: champion is Sarah Lim (prod). Max to intro Sarah -> Priya + Solutions Eng (Avery) for POC scope. Need to prepare POC success criteria: latency < 250ms p50, accuracy >= 85% on sample eval set, 2-week pilot.
- LatticeAI: Low embedding adoption. Possible reasons: SDK integration confusion, quota limits, or evaluation mismatch. Ask Max to pull recent logs showing embedding calls and error types.

Open questions for Max: 
- Which of these accounts require an exec escalation if we can’t get a fix within 48 hours? (I suspect NovaRetail qualifies)
- Any recent feedback from Onward Health legal on data residency?
- Are there any pricing talks I should avoid overlapping with sales? (i.e., intact discounts already promised)

Action items (owner — due):
- Max: Introduce Sarah Lim (ParkCorp) to Priya + Avery and confirm POC kickoff window — due 2026-03-13.
- Priya: Draft 1-pager "Performance troubleshooting for customers" (short, bulleted) and share in slack #ae-max-evans + attach to ParkCorp intro — due 2026-03-16.
- Priya + Ethan: Create a short timeline + next steps doc for NovaRetail (collect logs, reproduce, rollback plan) — due 2026-03-14.
- Avery: Prep POC checklist + template for ParkCorp (eng resources needed, test data, eval rubric) — due 2026-03-15.
- Max: Pull embedding usage logs for LatticeAI and share top 5 integration errors — due 2026-03-17.

Follow-up plan: 
- After 1:1, send summary note to Max with action items and owners + cc Ethan and Avery.
- Add NovaRetail to weekly "incidents" standup until resolved.
- Track ParkCorp POC progress in Confluence page (linked_artifacts).

Notes-to-self: keep this lightweight — Max is terse, likes concrete asks. Start meeting with 1 sentence win, then jump to critical risks. If NovaRetail needs exec escalation, prepare 1-paragraph TL;DR for VP Sales.

Quick reference links (add later if needed):
- Confluence: /account-playbook/ParkCorp-POC-template (to attach in follow-up)
- JIRA: JIRA-RI-7890 (NovaRetail latency ticket)
- Internal pricing doc: /pricing/hosted-api-q1-2026

Timestamp: 2026-03-12 09:10 (prep, before 1:1 at 10:00)
